description: This file contains unit tests for the AppManager component, including tests for setting and getting app properties, preloading, launching, closing, and terminating apps via JSON-RPC and COM-RPC interfaces. It also includes mock classes, event handling, and test cases for various sequences and error scenarios.

classes.name: AsyncHandlerMock_AppManager
